capabilities: animate the text cursor to move smoothly
display a motion trail as the cursor moves
toggle the trail effect on or off
customize cursor color, blink speed, trail color and speed
extras: Known issues documented: in Vim mode the cursor renders as a line instead of a block on headings, and the cursor may hide when a table cell contains non-plain text. Customization via styles.css requires restarting Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's text cursor jumps abruptly between positions, which some users find visually jarring while editing.
summary: Editor cursor effect plugin that animates the text cursor to glide smoothly to its target position, with an optional colored motion trail.
